san-cristobal-de-la-habana-cuba--linea-c.description: Launched in 1999 and named after Havana's original name of 1519, San Cristóbal de La Habana honours the city's past: its first sizes took the names of the fortresses that guarded the harbour, such as La Fuerza and El Príncipe. Wrapper and filler come from the Vuelta Abajo. Light to medium, it smokes savoury and gently sweet, with bark, leather and a rising cocoa note.

thirds.notes: Savoury with a sweet undertone: black pepper and bark, touches of leather and herbs, over an earthy, faintly floral base.
The savoury side comes into balance with the sweetness; bark and leather hold, and a clear cocoa aroma appears.
Sweetness leads as the bark deepens with dried fruit and spice; young examples can turn tannic here.

san-cristobal-de-la-habana-cuba--colecci.description: Beyond the regular range, San Cristóbal de La Habana is one of the brands given exclusive productions for La Casa del Habano. For the brand's 20th year and Havana's 500th, 2019 brought the 20 Aniversario, 52 x 162 mm in a special box, and the 1519, a 57 x 170 mm Roque made for 500 humidors of 100 cigars, each with an anniversary band.
